results.name: Logi Ergo K860 Keyboard
results.description: Logitech Ergonomic keyboard. High-quality, photo-realistic 3D model of a modern ergonomic split wireless keyboard with an integrated curved wrist rest, designed specifically for professional workspace renderings, corporate office setups, and architectural visualization. Built with clean, subdivision-ready quad-based geometry, this asset ensures smooth shading and flawless edge tension under subdivision surface modifiers without deformation. The model features fully unwrapped, non-overlapping UV coordinates with optimized texel density and clean padding. Materials are configured for native Blender Cycles and EEVEE rendering, utilizing high-resolution PBR textures (Base Color, Roughness, Metallic, Normal) to deliver authentic tactile matte plastic keycaps, crisp lettering, and a finely textured acoustic cushioned palm rest. The scene is fully optimized, scaled to real-world metric dimensions (1:1), centered at origin (0,0,0) with cleared transforms ($1.000$), and contains no extraneous lights, cameras, or orphan geometry.
